name: Veil Nebula

source.reference: Fesen, R. A., Weil, K. E., Cisneros, I. A., Blair, W. P., & Raymond, J. C. (2021), "An updated distance to the Cygnus Loop based on Gaia Early DR3", MNRAS, 507, 244 (arXiv:2109.05368, doi:10.1093/mnras/stab2066). Distance is the paper's own revised remnant-centre distance (725 +/- 15 pc), derived from Gaia EDR3 parallaxes of several stars identified (via high-velocity interstellar absorption lines) as located inside/behind the remnant - the same 'literature paper directly measuring the remnant's own distance' convention this catalog's other supernova_remnant record (Vela SNR) already uses (see that record's own source.reference), not a SIMBAD parallax/mesDistance value (SIMBAD carries neither for this extended object).

notes: Story #326 new-record gap-fill: a supernova remnant (issue's own explicit framing: "not a cloud/HII region"), NOT part of the Zucker et al. 2020 molecular-cloud compendium Stories #318/#324/#325 mined (that paper covers molecular clouds only) and NOT run through the molecular-cloud-specific acquisition script - acquired via this catalog's supernova_remnant convention instead, matching Vela SNR (the catalog's only other supernova_remnant record) field-for-field: a literature paper is the distance source (SIMBAD itself has no parallax and no mesDistance on file for any Cygnus Loop identifier tried live - 'NAME Cygnus Loop', 'NAME Veil Nebula'/NGC 6960, NGC 6992, NGC 6995 all confirmed empty), while position is SIMBAD's own identification-only query. Position/otype anchor: live SIMBAD query for 'NAME Cygnus Loop' resolves to main_id 'NAME Cyg Loop' (ra=312.75, dec=30.6667), otype 'SNR' (confirmed genuine SuperNova Remnant classification, not a generic ISM/shell label) - chosen over the sibling SIMBAD entry 'NAME Veil Nebula'/NGC 6960 (otype 'ISM', generic Interstellar Medium Object, one specific western filament/the 'Witch's Broom', 1.155 deg away - well within this remnant's own ~1.9 deg angular radius per its galdim_majaxis below) because 'NAME Cyg Loop' is SIMBAD's own whole-remnant SNR-typed entry, the correct anchor for a single-point/single-distance record representing the entire structure (same logic as Vela SNR anchoring to its own SNR-typed centroid rather than one filament). 725 pc is within the issue's own unverified ~700-735pc estimate and comfortably under the 800pc cap. The issue itself described this as "the catalog's SECOND supernova_remnant record (currently only Vela SNR exists)" - that framing turns out to be factually imprecise, caught during this Story's own acquisition rather than trusted blindly: M1/the Crab Nebula (id m1_crab, added by the earlier Messier-nebula-gap-fill batch, issue #221) is already object_type supernova_remnant too, so this is actually the catalog's THIRD supernova_remnant record (Vela SNR, M1/Crab Nebula, now Veil Nebula/Cygnus Loop), not the second - noted here rather than silently left uncorrected. visual.size_pc = 48.51 pc is a DIAMETER (this catalog's established supernova_remnant/molecular_cloud/hii_region/planetary_nebula convention, Story #314) derived from SIMBAD's own galdim_majaxis=230.0 arcmin for 'NAME Cyg Loop' (bibcode 2014BASI...42...47G, qual='D') via this record's own 725pc distance - qual 'D' (SIMBAD's own lowest angular-size quality flag) is noted honestly rather than silently treated as equivalent to the better-quality galdim values other records in this catalog carry.
